description:
Migrate the SoA parallelization threshold and chunk length to runtime resolved reads.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.2 and the soa_batch row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: parallel_min_len and parallel_chunk_len are runtime resolved reads at should_parallelize_soa_batch and the four parallel entry points, satisfying design §2.3, arithmetic unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: soa_parallel_route reporter called by the dispatcher, boundary route files, and a determinism witness that a changed chunk length leaves results identical, all pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc names the profile fields; existing tests pass unchanged with no profile installed.
title: Cut the SoA batch selectors over to the tuning profile
